name: Viceroy Hotels Ltd
title: Viceroy Hotels Ltd - 523796 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Viceroy Hotels Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 77% to INR44.9 crore and EBITDA rose 144% to INR11.8 crore, with PAT turning positive at INR1.4 crore.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue from operations reached INR44.9 crore against INR25.4 crore a year earlier, and EBITDA margin expanded to 26.3% from 19%. Courtyard reopened with full 168-key inventory after Phase 1 renovation, pushing its occupancy to 83.65% and RevPAR to INR5,006. Combined ADR fell about 12% as lower-paying corporate, army and airline business was added to fill rooms while the Marriott convention centre was offline from April for Phase 2 work. Higher depreciation (INR5 crore) and finance cost (INR5.4 crore, from INR1 crore) absorbed most of the EBITDA, leaving PAT of INR1.4 crore.

financial_highlights.change: +144% YoY from INR4.8 crore; margin +725 bps from 19%
vs loss of INR3 crore (-11.9% margin) in Q1 FY26

financial_highlights.value: Standalone INR220 crore; consolidated INR259 crore
financial_highlights.change: Net debt standalone ~INR180 crore; consolidated ~INR220 crore; blended rate 8.7%

segments.name: Marriott Hotel (ex-EA)
segments.commentary: Occupancy 72.04% (from 59.96%), ADR INR6,188, RevPAR up 5.7% to INR4,457. Convention centre offline from first week of April for Phase 2 upgrade, constraining banquet revenue.

segments.name: Courtyard (168 keys)
segments.commentary: Occupancy 83.65% (from 38.31%), ADR INR5,985 (down about 9.9%), RevPAR nearly doubled to INR5,006 from INR2,545. Phase 1 renovation complete.

segments.name: Marriott Executive Apartments
segments.commentary: Occupancy 94% (from 83%), ADR INR13,342 (+7.5%), RevPAR INR12,519 (+21.1%). Acquired and debt-funded (about INR200 crore); first full financial year in FY27.

guidance_outlook: EBITDA margin targeted above 30% in FY27, with 40% as long-term benchmark once renovation is complete.
Phase 2 (Marriott, including convention centre) expected to finish by December 2026 (Q3 FY27); EBITDA displacement from Phase 2 estimated at about INR10 crore in FY27.
Courtyard target: occupancy 80-85% over the next two financial years; ADR rising from about INR6,800 toward INR8,500, with management suggesting INR9,000-9,500 by FY28.
Management aims to beat prior-year quarterly numbers in each remaining quarter of FY27.
Q2 FY27 described as strong with good business already booked.
Greenfield 200-key Courtyard at Madhapur: approvals expected this year, construction start targeted Q4 FY27, operations FY29-FY30; project cost INR120-130 crore.
capex_capacity: Phase 1 (Courtyard, 56 additional rooms, spa, gym, rooftop bar, pool; about INR50 crore) complete; Courtyard revenue expected to exceed INR50 crore in first year vs about INR30 crore in prior full calendar year.
Phase 2 (Marriott convention centre upgrade) runs April to December 2026; Phase 3 also at Marriott. Renovation programme completes with Phase 3.
Consolidated capital work-in-progress about INR8 crore as of 30 June 2026, mostly Courtyard; standalone close to the same.
Debt-equity ratio close to 1; management sees capacity for about INR100 crore additional debt.
Rights issue under approval with exchanges, around INR107 crore, to repay debt and keep headroom for Greenfield; aim is to bring promoter holding below 75% by October as mandated by SEBI.
demand_pricing: Combined ADR INR6,107 vs INR6,952 (about -12%); management attributes this to renovation-constrained room inventory last year, convention centre offline, war-related drop in foreign demand, and mix shift to army and airline business.
Management says RevPAR is the key metric; combined RevPAR up 24.85% to INR4,657.
Executive apartments international mix about 20% in Q1-Q2, up to about 40% in peak season; hotel international mix 15-20%.
Hyderabad ADR growth expected at 10-12% for upscale segment per consultant studies cited by management.
Marriott fees: about 1-1.5% of total revenue and about 6-7% of GOP; management says fee structure is stable and Greenfield contract ties GOP fee to GOP margin.

qa_highlights.question: How much EBITDA displacement is expected in FY27 from Phase 2?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR10 crore combined from lost convention and room business; no permanent loss of business claimed.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Greenfield Courtyard status and timeline?
qa_highlights.answer: Awaiting government approval under new Telangana tourism policy; designs ready; construction start expected Q4 FY27, operations FY29-FY30.

qa_highlights.question: What are standalone and consolidated debt and net debt?
qa_highlights.answer: Total debt INR220 crore standalone and INR259 crore consolidated; net debt about INR180 crore standalone and INR220 crore consolidated; blended rate 8.7%.

qa_highlights.question: What is the dividend policy and promoter pledge status?
qa_highlights.answer: Board to discuss dividend after Phase 2 and convention centre return; promoters have not pledged any shares.

qa_highlights.question: What are Courtyard ADR and occupancy targets?
qa_highlights.answer: Occupancy 80-85% for next two years; ADR from about INR6,800 toward INR8,500, possibly INR9,000-9,500 by FY28; renovated rooms ADR about INR9,000.

qa_highlights.question: What is the rights issue purpose and size?
qa_highlights.answer: Around INR107 crore; mainly to repay debt and keep borrowing headroom for Greenfield; awaiting exchange approval.

qa_highlights.question: Why did EBITDA margin fall sequentially from Q4 to Q1?
qa_highlights.answer: Management called Q1 seasonally weaker across the industry; expects margin above 30% for FY27 as Q3-Q4 strengthen.

qa_highlights.question: Is the Marriott Executive Apartments acquisition PAT accretive?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said PAT is after interest and depreciation; debt drawn 1 January 2026; combined EBITDA run-rate cited by analyst about INR21.45 crore for the asset.
